{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsorlift motors''' were components used in several fields. They were used as components in [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and were included in [[Ulqib MicroTronics]]' [[droid customization kit]]. When installed, droid were able to use the repulsorlift motor to move around. Repulsorlift motors were also built into the [[Repulsor throwing razor/Legends|repulsor throwing razor]]. They enhanced the range and damage of the weapon, and were a part of the retrieval system in tandem with a [[homing transponder]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>

An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial asteroid base|asteroid base]] had a facility dedicated to producing low-yield repulsorlift motors. The motors were intended for use in the [[collector-repulsor array]] [[Gravity/Legends|gravitic]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] that the Empire was constructing.<ref name="Science">{{WEGCite|story=Ain't Science Grand?|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
